name: OBD Y-Splitter (Deutsch DT 6P)
description: 1:1 pass-through Y-adapter on the Harley M8 diagnostic port. Bike side DT06-6S -> two DT04-6P branches (Jekill & Hyde stays connected + RoundDash CAN tap). Only CAN-H/CAN-L are tapped for RoundDash.
notes: The 6-pin diagnostic port carries CAN-H/CAN-L, GND and 12 V on separate pins (12 V is NOT on the CAN lines). Verify pin positions with a multimeter (~60 Ohm across the CAN pair). No termination resistor in the stub. The port 12 V is only weakly fused - for a display prefer a separate switched 12 V feed.
